# &Now

> &Now is an IT and process consulting practice in Indonesia. It improves how a business works before digitising it, then builds the software or website around the better process. Work is available in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

Website: https://andnowhq.com (English: https://andnowhq.com/?lang=en, Bahasa Indonesia: https://andnowhq.com/?lang=id)
Email: hello@andnowhq.com
WhatsApp: +62 851-7333-6932 (https://wa.me/6285173336932)

## What &Now does

- Improve your process: understand how work happens today, clarify responsibilities and redesign the steps that get in the way.
- Custom software: turn the improved process into software the team can use, with clear steps and handovers.
- Web presence: websites that help customers understand what a business does and take the next step. Designed, hosted and maintained by &Now.
- Curated solution: software built for specific ways of working. An existing product may be all a business needs.

## How a project runs

1. Understand: walk through how work actually gets done, including the workarounds the team relies on.
2. Improve: remove unnecessary steps, clarify who does what and agree how the process should work.
3. Digitise: choose and build the tools that support the improved process, then test them with the team.
4. Refine: support the team, review how the system works in practice and adjust as the business changes.

## Selected work

- PT Acosystem Advisory Indonesia (advisory, website): founders, SME owners and foreign investors all landed on one page with no clear way in. &Now built a site that asks who you are first, then sends you straight to the right partner.
- DIMAS, FMCG distributor in East Java (delivery system and website): deliveries ran on paper and WhatsApp. &Now built a proof of delivery app where drivers log every drop with photo, signature, cash and GPS. The office now tracks every route live and checks the cash against the app.
- Sunday Table, home bakery in Surabaya (ordering system): orders came in as loose Instagram messages that had to be retyped. &Now built an ordering site where customers pick what they want themselves. Every order now arrives complete and in one place.

## In-house products

- LedFlow (https://ledflowapp.com): imports Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop exports into Accurate Online, without retyping.
- Westra (https://getwestra.com): schedules, credit packs, attendance and payment reminders for lesson studios, in one place.
- Sumaru (coming soon): accounting for Indonesian SMEs. Invoices, bank and reports, without needing to be an accountant.

## Common questions

- Do we need new software? Not always. Sometimes clearer responsibilities or a simpler process solve the problem. &Now works out what needs improving before recommending what to digitise.
- What does a project cost? It depends on what needs fixing and what needs building, so the first step is a free 30-minute call. Most projects take 4-12 weeks. If there is work to do, scope and price are agreed in writing before anything starts.
- Can you work with the system we already use? Often, yes. The aim is to improve how things work, which may mean adapting the current system rather than replacing it.
- Who hosts and maintains it after launch? &Now can host and maintain what it builds. Everything is documented and the code belongs to the client, so another developer can always take over.
- Can everything be in Bahasa Indonesia? Yes. Conversations, documents and the software itself can be in Bahasa Indonesia, English, or both.
